An '''HK-87 droid leader''' was in command of a unit of [[HK-87 assassin droid]]s serving [[Witch]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]]. The droid had a [[Color|dark grey]] [[photoreceptor]] and was painted in dark red. It carried an [[electrostaff]] and wore a tattered grey cloak.<ref name="Part 1">{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}}</ref>

In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[droid]]s were sent to retrieve a [[Arcana Star Map|star map]] depicting the [[Pathway to Peridea]] from a [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Nightsisters' Temple|stronghold]] on the [[planet]] [[Arcana]], but instead encountered and ambushed former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] who had [[Mission to Arcana|collected it]] herself. The leader stayed back while the four droids of the unit closed in on Tano and attempted to slash her with their [[electrostaff]]s, but the Jedi trapped them in the stronghold's basement by jumping inside and opening holes on the ceiling with [[Ahsoka Tano's white lightsabers|her]] [[lightsaber]]s. The leader then attacked her themselves, engaging in a brief duel, but Tano quickly overpowered and decapitated them. Following their leader's destruction, the four surviving droids activated their failsafe [[Self-destruct mechanism|explosive charges]], forcing Tano to run away to escape their detonation.<ref name="Part 1" />
